name: gstack-evals planning R1a model policy
source: CREW.md, the gstack-evals Captain's rules: Sonnet 5.5 has the roles of the other current models, judge included (Garry, 2026-10-29: "tbh sonnet is good now maybe we shouldn't have gstack say no sonnet"), and the judge is chosen per preregistration with an Opus 5.5 preference stated in docs/skill-eval.md; particle-1 is a model under test (Garry, 2026-10-29: "also can you add particle-1 as a model everywhere?", GST-225), with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, particle-1's base, beside it as a fixed ladder rung; the newest generation of each family only; never gpt-5.4-mini; Fable only in smoke tests. Other projects pass their own file with --policy. Planning R1a (wiki/plans/2026-10-31-geva-83-planning-r1a-prereg): this copy of the default adds the ledger item planning-r1a to claude-fable-5-1's rungs, so Fable 5.1 runs as a capped rung only in that item (Garry, 2026-10-31, "Do it" on GST-659).
